items.title: Canton roadmap leads with tokenized stocks, then repo and derivatives
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 12, 2026 · 10:33 AM ET)
- **Canton roadmap leads with tokenized stocks, then repo and derivatives** — Digital Asset CEO Yuval Rooz set out the sequence in an X Space: tokenized equities first, following the first trades under the SEC's Innovation Exemption, then repo trading, derivatives and private assets (BSCN)
- **Progmat signs with Digital Asset to tokenize Japanese government bonds on Canton** — The MOU builds tokenized JGBs (tJGB) with live pilot testing this month by a working group of more than 68 institutions, including MUFG, targeting 24/7 on-chain repo settlement (Genfinity)
- **DTCC Tokenization Service is live on Canton, covering Treasuries, equities and ETFs** — The service launched October 28 with Morgan Stanley reported as an early user; DTCC also co-chairs Canton's governance alongside Euroclear (Cryptensive)

Network: CC $0.0909 | Market cap $3.6B (rank 27) | 24h volume $12.7M | Supply 40.0B CC (CoinGecko via Crypheat)
